subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers permanently fail closed on legacy ownerless session rows, or should upgrades provide a safe ownership migration or documented recovery path?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes authority over persisted session state; source correctness cannot determine the repository's desired upgrade and recovery policy.

options.title: Fail closed with recovery
options.body: Keep the restriction, document how an operator or non-plugin client recovers legacy rows, and require deployed proof of the transition.

options.title: Add doctor migration
options.body: Introduce a narrowly verified migration that establishes safe ownership before plugin-runtime patch access is enforced.

options.title: Defer ownerless restriction
options.body: Land the foreign-owner fence while tracking legacy ownerless-row policy as separate ownership work.

recommendation.title: Fail closed with recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the restriction, document how an operator or non-plugin client recovers legacy rows, and require deployed proof of the transition.

likelyOwner.reason: The primary historical contributor across the central session implementation is the best available owner for this persisted-state policy decision.
